exactPrompt: Create exactly one 1254×1254 RGB PNG provider-source raster for the tier F (Common) rarity-frame layer. Use the supplied Option C comparison only as visual authority; do not crop, trace, or reuse source pixels. Use the supplied geometry guide only as a registration and role-mask reference, never as image content. Place every part of the frame material entirely inside the guide's blue-and-white allowed annulus plus the top-center medallion zone. Leave the entire central area inside the cyan inner boundary and the entire area outside the white outer boundary as uninterrupted chroma field. Do not render or copy the guide colors, dashed line, boundary overlays, construction marks, labels, or UI. Preserve the shared point-up hexagonal geometry and exact registration after the pipeline's full-canvas resize to 1024×1024. Build a weathered iron frame with a narrow undecorated rim, hammered wear, and nearly hidden rivets. Include one small integrated top-center medallion bearing only the uppercase letter F. The frame must form a substantial continuous rim along all six sides and remain legible at 96 pixels after normalization. Render the asset on a perfectly uniform opaque #00FF00 matte with no baked checkerboard. Every required chroma-field region must contain no simulated transparency, shadows, texture, gradient, color variation, or other marks. Use no green-colored material, green reflections, green oxidation, or green patina anywhere in the frame. Do not add a cast shadow, ambient-occlusion halo, or dark fringe across the forbidden central or exterior green regions; the chroma field must meet every frame edge cleanly. The pipeline will remove the source matte, resize the raster, and apply the fixed rarity-frame role mask. No skill icon, emblem, backing, scenery, glow, or any other symbol, number, word, label, or text. Output only this isolated provider-source raster.

failureReason.message: Corrected provider source remained ineligible: deterministic normalization rejected it because the #00FF00 edge matte was not sufficiently clean; retry ceiling exhausted.
